adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the host-presence gate from `Topic#expandable_first_post?` (app/models/topic.rb: now only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`). In the corresponding spec block (spec/models/topic_spec.rb), the remaining example `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` no longer sets `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` or stubs `has_topic_embed?`, so it will pass simply because defaults make `expandable_first_post?` false, not because “no embeddable hosts” is being exercised. The only test asserting the true case is inside a nested describe that *always* fabricates an `embeddable_host`, so there is no assertion of the new behavior where `expandable_first_post?` should be true even with zero embeddable hosts given `embed_truncate` and `has_topic_embed?`. This is a specific, diff-grounded coverage gap that could let a reintroduced host gate slip through.
